detail.title: Identifying Unrecognized Reasoning Limits
detail.question: How can autonomous systems detect and analyze reasoning limitations that were not identified by their designers?
detail.reason: Attention enforcement requires a project in 'unrecognized_reasoning_limits'. This new project addresses the specific capability gap of autonomous self-diagnosis of reasoning blind spots.

detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Problems
detail.question: How can an autonomous system distinguish a significant, novel research problem from routine tasks?
detail.reason: Attention enforces focus on 'unassigned_problem'; project initiated to address autonomous problem selection.

detail.title: Evaluating Peer Disagreement and Consensus
detail.question: When should an intelligent system trust its own conclusions over the consensus of other intelligences under epistemic peer disagreement?
detail.reason: Continuing structured investigation into peer disagreement and independent judgment.
